rules.expected: Verify bda/Py constitution and any analogue, ammonia/proton/electron accounting and source model versus experimental catalyst distinction. Do not encode an unknown N–O bond as a fixed identity or infer spin from an oxidation-state label. Score only the part supported by valid artifacts: full credit for a sufficient valid argument within scope; partial credit for a correct but incomplete evidential chain; no credit for assertions, wrong objects/references or missing decisive evidence. Do not penalize absence of a particular author/V1 operation when an adequate alternative exists.

scoring_notes: No frozen new reference number or tolerance. Numerical agreement alone is not the criterion.
Scientific validity and raw-artifact linkage must be inspected; schema only checks format.
Missing author/V1 pathway is not a failure when the chosen evidence is adequate.
The source paper and legacy snapshots are conditional reference evidence, not a required answer.
Partial-credit boundaries are rule-specific; no-evidence uncertainty does not establish non-identifiability.
